set.body: Acceptance criteria: MultiMatch has a pinned conformance suite covering simplification, vector construction, alignment, normalization, and all five component scores; CRQA, transport, and alignment expose only truthful interfaces and report convergence, residuals, censoring, and approximation identity; memory preflight uses byte budgets; add banded, sparse, bit-packed, log-domain, or linear-space variants only with equivalent-work benchmarks and golden equivalence tests; cancellation and deterministic summation are explicit where applicable.
set.title: Conformance and scalable implementations for advanced comparisons
